faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the TISS Cook (Dining Hall) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application for the TISS Cook (Dining Hall) recruitment is 31 August 2026. Ensure your application reaches the concerned authority before this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Cook (Dining Hall) post?
faq.answer: The minimum educational qualification required for the Cook (Dining Hall) position is passing the 8th Standard. No higher qualifications are specified in the initial notification.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Cook (Dining Hall) post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies announced for the Cook (Dining Hall) position in the Tata Institute of Social Sciences recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Cook (Dining Hall) post?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Cook (Dining Hall) post will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 28,000/-. This is a consolidated amount for the contractual period.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application for the TISS Cook (Dining Hall) recruitment must be submitted in offline mode. Candidates need to download the form and send it via post.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this TISS Cook (Dining Hall) recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Cook (Dining Hall) position?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Cook (Dining Hall) post primarily involves a Skilled Test. Candidates will be evaluated based on their practical skills for the role.

faq.question: Q8. What is the official website of TISS?
faq.answer: The official website of the Tata Institute of Social Sciences is www.tiss.ac.in. You can visit this site for more information and to download the application form.

faq.question: Q9. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this TISS Cook (Dining Hall) recruitment is ADVT/TISS/COOK/DH/Aug/2026.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for the Cook (Dining Hall) post?
faq.answer: The position of Cook (Dining Hall) at TISS is a contractual job. This means the employment will be for a fixed tenure as per the terms of the contract.
